card.name: Orientation in mental status checks
card.fires_on: The word orientation or oriented when it names a cognitive function, in lists of mental status or confusion symptoms, next to memory, language and thinking.

modes.label: Orientation in symptom lists
modes.description: The word orientation appears as one item in a list of cognitive functions such as memory and language.
modes.example: changes in thinking, memory, and<< orientation>> leading to confusion and personality changes.

modes.label: Oriented in an assessment
modes.description: The word oriented appears in a bedside assessment item asking if the patient knows the year, month, city or hospital.
modes.example: assess: Orientation (<<oriented>> to year, month, city, hospital
